construction: Hash and KDF derivations of the §13.3 label registry
spec: §2.4.2 (social recovery key), §12.6 (WebAuthn PRF), §5.1.1 / §14.4.2 (commit stream), §10.3.4.6 (Mainline DHT infohash), §13.3
notes: Fixed inputs named by a label are SHA-256(UTF-8("agora-test-vectors/" || label)), truncated to the stated length.
socialRecoveryKey: seed = HKDF-SHA256(IKM = S, salt = zero-length, info = "agora/v1/social-recovery-key", L = 32), used as an Ed25519 seed. S is fixed here.
webauthnPrfWrap: wrapping key = HKDF-SHA256(IKM = PRF output, salt = zero-length, info = "agora/v1/webauthn-prf-wrap", L = 32). The PRF output is fixed here.
commitStream: SHA-256("agora/commits/v1" || channelToken), channelToken = keyEpoch 0 token of channel-token.json.
relayInfohash: SHA-1 of the 14 ASCII bytes "agora-relay-v1".
